summary: Kitchen island is clean and tidy with minimal hazards detected.

hazards.title: Pot lid placed near island edge
hazards.detail: Heavy enameled cast iron lid rests close to the counter edge, risking drops.
fixSteps: Move the pot lid farther back toward the center of the countertop.
Place the lid securely back onto the Dutch oven when not in use.
